title: nan
authors: Elamin A.; El-Rabbany A.; Jacob S.
key_contribution: Presents an event-based visual-inertial odometry approach for UAV indoor navigation in GNSS-denied environments, evaluated on simulated and real-world datasets with real-time performance.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Filter_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
